title: Huhu, interested in a dystopian roguelike game to fight AI taking over all humans jobs? -solo dev
author: tjb-studio
selftext:
I think you will like this if you like cynical dark humor and roguelike games!

Deprecation is about the last engineer after AI took every job. You fight back with code. This is a short teaser, captured with Godot’s movie maker mode and cut in Remotion with Claude.

The engineer’s idle, hurt, death, jumping animations are my own doodles bent by script. The walk and jump are small rig mixed with frame-by-frame art.

The room is a plain grey corporate office on purpose. I wanted a place you could actually get laid off in, not a sci-fi lab.

Status: not playable yet. Building in public. Second devlog: [https://deprecation.org/devlog/2-the-laptop-shoots-back](https://deprecation.org/devlog/2-the-laptop-shoots-back)

**Art disclosure:** the player and everything around his "world" is based on my own hand-drawn doodles then digitalised using illustrator. The enemies and everything related to AI are generated with Adobe Firefly which is commercially safe. This is on purpose because in the story you are literally fighting AI

To promote this, I made a fun dystopian and but too real to be true website that will tell you when AI will replace your job: [deprecation.org](http://deprecation.org)

Would you would play this?
